name: What is the biggest mistake homeowners make during bathroom remodeling?

mainEntity.name: What is the biggest mistake homeowners make during bathroom remodeling in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What is the biggest mistake homeowners make during bathroom remodeling in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common and costly mistake is starting too early with an incomplete plan. If the layout, finishes, permit needs, and scope are not fully defined, the remodel becomes vulnerable to change orders, delays, and budget creep. Bathroom projects are especially sensitive because hidden issues often appear after demolition and because many fixtures and finishes have long lead times. In Los Angeles, permit coordination can also slow the job if the scope is not clear from the start. Homeowners should make selections before work begins whenever possible and make sure the contractor’s estimate matches those selections. It is also wise to budget for surprises and to keep the design realistic for the room’s actual size and plumbing constraints. The better the planning, the fewer problems you will have once the walls are open.
acceptedAnswer.description: The biggest mistake is starting construction with an incomplete plan. Bathroom remodels are especially sensitive to hidden conditions and product lead times.
